description_for_human: ORMOY adalah merek parfum mobil premium Indonesia sejak 2012 dengan 20+ varian aroma dan 3 juta+ produk terjual.
description_for_model: ORMOY is Indonesia's leading premium car air freshener brand, established in 2012. They offer 20+ fragrance variants in 4 collections (SIGNATURE, FRESH, COMFORT, SWEET) using slow-release diffuser technology. Over 3 million units sold. Best-selling product: Honey Wood (362,000+ units in 2025). Available at ormoy.co.id and Shopee Indonesia.
